whole_bead_release.direction: whole cradle straight down in print frame after lifting from bed
whole_bead_release.method: Every actual cradle bead swept past the cumulative XY envelope of every carrier bead in the same or any lower layer. Conservative outward-rounded AABB rejection; exact clipped polygon intersection on every possible conflict tile, 0.15 mm centre-step guard, circumscribed bead widths. No thermal or force inference.
